Class ECMWFActionForm

java.lang.Object
org.apache.struts.action.ActionForm
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.controller.ECMWFActionForm
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ApiClientActionForm, CategoryActionForm, CertificatesActionForm, DataFileActionForm, DestinationActionForm, DetailActionForm, EcTransModuleActionForm, FilterActionForm, HostActionForm, IncomingPolicyActionForm, IncomingUserActionForm, MetaDataActionForm, RatesActionForm, ResourceActionForm, TransferGroupActionForm, TransferMethodActionForm, TransferServerActionForm, TreeActionForm, UploadActionForm, UserActionForm
public class ECMWFActionForm extends org.apache.struts.action.ActionForm
Extends the struts ActionForm providing utility methods to:
  • Get and set "path parameters" from and into paths.
  • Check field validity.
  • Handle errors
Created: Fri Jun 7 13:47:24 2002

    • adaptActionForward

      public static org.apache.struts.action.ActionForward adaptActionForward(org.apache.struts.action.ActionForward forward, String parameter) throws ECMWFActionFormException
      Takes an action forward and, if it ends with "*", substitutes the "*" by a parameter. It is used when the ActionForward depends both on the struts-config.xml file and on some application parameter.
      Parameters:
      forward - The original ActionForward
      parameter - What to put instead of the asterisk.
      Returns:
      A new ActionForward with the new path.
      Throws:
      ECMWFActionFormException

    • adaptActionForward

      @Deprecated public static org.apache.struts.action.ActionForward adaptActionForward(org.apache.struts.action.ActionForward forward, String parameter1, String parameter2) throws ECMWFActionFormException
      Deprecated.
      So far it is not needed. Could be used in the future.
      Takes an action forward and, if it ends with "*", substitutes the "*" by a parameter. It is used when the ActionForward depends both on the struts-config.xml file and on some application parameter. This version of the method allows sthe usage of two parameters.
      Parameters:
      forward - The original ActionForward
      parameter1 - What to put instead of the first asterisk.
      parameter2 - What to put instead of the second asterisk.
      Returns:
      A new ActionForward with the new path.
      Throws:
      ECMWFActionFormException

    • newErrors

      public static org.apache.struts.action.ActionMessages newErrors(String key, ECMWFException e)
      Creates an ActionMessages object from a key and a ModelException. The resulting ActionMessages is going to contain as many ActionError elements as the length chain of nested exceptions stored in the ModelException (getParent method).
      Parameters:
      key - The key used to lookup the error message in ECMWFResources.properties
      e - The ModelException whose message chain is going to be taken.
      Returns:
      The ActionMessages object.

    • getErrors

      public org.apache.struts.action.ActionErrors getErrors()
      Every ECMWFActionForm keeps its own list of errors, resulting from from validation failures. This method gets them.
      Returns:
      The list of form validation failures.

    • cleanErrors

      public void cleanErrors()
      Resets the error list, coming from validation failures. If the ECMWFActionForm is stored in the session, the list need to be cleaned between form invocations or the errors will just aggregate, preventing any submission after the first error.

    • validateContent

      public boolean validateContent(Content content, String attribute, String contentType, String message)
      Check if some Content is VALID, using a ContentProcessorService content processor, the one configured to validate its content type, adding an error to the internal list with some message if not.
      Parameters:
      content - The Content object to check
      attribute - The name of the content object attribute which contains the actual content
      contentType - The content type of the supplied content
      message - The message to add to the errors list if the test fails.
      Returns:
      If the validation succeed.

      • ContentProcessor

    • convertToDate

      public Date convertToDate(String value, String[] formats)
      This method converts a value into a Date, increasing/creating the errors object if everything fails. First it will try to parse the formatDateTime format. If it fails, the second formatDate will ve tried. If EVERYTHING fails an error will be issued.
      Parameters:
      value - The string literal
      formatDateTime - A format which includes a the date and the time.
      formatDate - A format only including the date. The time supplied will be the current one (now).
      Returns:
      The Date object.
